name: BBQ Salmon OR Trout
description: Salmon or trout fillets marinated in onion soup mix and Clamato juice, grilled to perfection in foil.
recipeIngredient: 2 large fillets of salmon or trout
Citrus and pepper seasoning (e.g., Club House brand)

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and clean the fillets. Place skin side down on aluminum foil.
Sprinkle the contents of the onion soup mix evenly over the fillets.
Add butter on top of the fillets.
Squeeze the juice of ½ lemon over the fillets and slice the remaining ½ for garnish.
Add citrus and pepper seasoning to taste.
Pour Clamato juice over the fillets.
Wrap the foil over the fillets, sealing the seams tightly.
Cook on a barbecue on medium-high heat on the bottom rack for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

keywords: BBQ salmon, BBQ trout, grilled fish, Clamato juice marinade

_similar.name: Richard's Sunday Soup
_similar.description: A rich and comforting soup featuring carrots, potatoes, and chicken stock.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel and dice the carrots and potato. Combine diced onion and oil in a saucepan and cook over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots and potato to the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chicken stock and sugar. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Remove from heat and puree. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

_similar.keywords: carrot soup, potato soup, chicken stock

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

_similar.keywords: vegetable soup, beef broth, savory soup

_similar.name: Seafood Chowder
_similar.description: A hearty seafood chowder featuring shrimp, clams, potatoes, and creamed corn in a flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté chopped bacon in a saucepan until cooked, then drain off excess fat.
Sauté the chopped onion and cubed potatoes in the bacon fat until tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (shrimp, clams, milk, creamed corn, broth, Worcestershire sauce) to the saucepan.
Heat through and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

_similar.keywords: seafood chowder, shrimp and clam soup, creamy chowder

_similar.name: Chicken Celebrity
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup
